description: Golden evaluation set for the CHRIST student helpdesk chatbot. 'keywords' is a list of fact groups; each group is a set of acceptable alternatives separated by '|'. A group counts as covered if any alternative appears in the answer (case-insensitive).

questions.question: What is the minimum attendance required to write the end semester exams?
questions.reference: A minimum of 85% attendance is required to write the End Semester Examinations.

questions.question: Above what attendance percentage will my leave application be accepted?
questions.reference: Leave applications are accepted only if actual attendance is above 75%.

questions.question: If I come late to class but the teacher lets me in, do I get attendance?
questions.reference: No. Attendance is marked at the beginning of class and late arrivals do not get attendance even if allowed to sit in.
keywords: no|not given|not be given|won't|will not|do not get|don't get

questions.question: I was absent for four days because I was sick. Within how many days must I submit the leave form?
questions.reference: For absence of more than two days, a signed leave form must be submitted within ten days of the leave period.

questions.question: What happens if a student is absent for two weeks without permission?
questions.reference: Absence of two weeks or more without written permission from the Vice Chancellor is treated as the student having left the university.

questions.question: How many periods are there in the forenoon and afternoon sessions?
questions.reference: Four periods in the forenoon session and two in the afternoon session.

questions.question: Where can parents get login details to see attendance online?
questions.reference: Parents can obtain login details from the IPM office.

questions.question: What is the address of the Yeshwanthpur campus?
questions.reference: Nagasandra, near Tumkur Road, Bengaluru 560073.

questions.question: Where is the Delhi NCR campus of Christ located?
questions.reference: Mariam Nagar, Meerut Road, Ghaziabad 201003.

questions.question: What is the admissions email for the Bannerghatta Road campus?
questions.reference: admissions.bgr@christuniversity.in

questions.question: What is the toll-free number for the Delhi NCR campus admissions?
I missed an end semester exam. Is there any way to write it again?
questions.reference: Yes, supplementary examinations allow students who could not appear for a scheduled ESE to complete the missed courses; notifications are on the Examination Notifications page.

questions.question: I have a backlog because my CIA marks were low. What can I apply for?
questions.reference: You can apply for a CIA Repeat.

questions.question: Which centre in the university provides counselling to students?
questions.reference: The Centre for Counselling and Health Services (CCHS).

questions.question: Can our class submit a group petition to complain about the timetable?
questions.reference: No. Students may not file complaints or petitions as a group; concerns can be presented individually or through proper representatives.

questions.question: Do I need permission to join a club or society?
questions.reference: Yes, prior permission from the Vice Chancellor is needed.

questions.question: Can I park my car inside the campus?
questions.reference: Four-wheelers can be parked inside the campus only on payment of the prescribed fee.

questions.question: How many parent meetings does CCHS organise each year?
questions.reference: Two parent meetings every academic year, one online and one offline.

questions.question: When was Christ University founded and what was it originally called?
questions.reference: It was founded in 1969 as Christ College.

questions.question: Which campus has the School of Engineering and Technology?
questions.reference: The Kengeri Campus on Mysore Road.
